optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided materials establish that the candidate has experience in building weekly schedules, resolving conflicts with shift managers, aligning material call-offs, reporting adherence, and documenting open items. They do not establish the candidate’s ability to hold ground under pressure or leadership style.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review is required to assess interview signals and confirm leadership stance.

evidence.text: Production planner at a carton packaging plant with six converting lines for four years, building each week's line schedule from the order book and the capacities of the six lines under the plant's scheduling procedure.

Resolved the schedule conflicts raised by the three shift managers in the daily schedule meeting, with the conflict log recording each challenge, the resolution and the schedule adherence afterwards; adherence stayed above the plant target in fifteen of the sixteen quarters.
Kept the material call-offs aligned with the schedule with the materials buyer through the weekly call-off review.
Reported schedule adherence to the plant manager each week, recording in the report which schedule changes were mine and which were the plant manager's decisions.
Wrote the open items list and the hand-over conditions for the next planning week at each weekly report.
